name: A Lost Purse
text: A purse lies in the ash, heavier than it looks.

name: A Wanderer's Pack
text: Someone left in a hurry. Their pack is still here.

name: A Forgotten Forge
text: The anvil is still warm. Something was left on it.

name: A Shrine Offering
text: A small shrine holds something old and humming.

name: The Relic Peddler
text: A cloaked peddler unrolls a cloth of curios. For a price.

name: An Essence Well
text: Rift light pools here, thick enough to bottle.

name: A Rusted Key
text: Half-buried: a key to one of the rift's old vaults.

name: The Ancient Reliquary
text: Behind a sealed door, something old and terrible waits on a plinth.
